description: This file defines the 'Country' model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve country data from the database, including by ID, ISO codes, and fetching all countries.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Model class for handling country data, including retrieval by ID, ISO codes, and listing all countries.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a country record by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Retrieves a country record by its ISO 2-letter code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Retrieves a country record by its ISO 3-letter code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves all active countries, with caching.
